summary: The draft's central comparator (the Aleliunas et al. 2m(n-1) bound) and the Lovász survey are named but not cited, and the resistance/Matthews and ridge-regression statements are unsupported; three targeted retrievals close these gaps.

rewrite_targets.reason: The 2m(n-1) bound is the paper's headline comparator and is attributed only by author name ('Aleliunas et al.') in the Introduction and Related Work, with no \cite; the Lovász survey is also named without a citation. The bib holds only the two Feige papers, so the primary comparator is uncited.
